title: A functional on test forms with local coefficient-sup-norm bounds is sequentially continuous at zero
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set and L : TestFormOn U n → ℝ any function. Assume that for every compact K ⊆ U there is A ∈ ℝ such that |L(ω)| ≤ A·C for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n and every C > 0 with tsupport ω ⊆ K and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ C for all x ∈ ℝ^P. Then for every sequence (ω_q) in TestFormOn U n with TestFormOnConverges ω 0, L(ω_q) → 0 as q → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (L : TestFormOn U n → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ A : ℝ, ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → tsupport ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) ⊆ K → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C) → |L ω| ≤ A * C) → ∀ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n, TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → Tendsto (fun q => L (ωs q)) atTop (𝓝 0)
